title: Tischkarte question corpus
description: Each shipped language stores its independent corpus in questions/{lang}/questions.yaml. A question is stored once and may be eligible for more than one physical deck.

id.description: q- + first 8 hex chars of SHA-256 of `lang|normalized text`. Assigned by validate.py --fix, never hand-written. Stable forever once assigned; later edits do not change it.

text.description: The question. 10-140 characters, must end with a configured terminator plus an optional closing quote or bracket, no newlines, no leading/trailing whitespace.

decks.description: One or more selector positions where this question may appear. Deck membership is eligibility, not ownership; store the question once.

depth.description: Editorial exposure cost: 1 asks little public exposure, 2 asks for a personal construction, 3 may ask for vulnerability, conflict, fear, loss, or consequential disclosure. It is independent of tone.

tags.description: Optional controlled vocabulary. `dark` marks morbid or macabre tone; `spicy` marks socially risky or risqué tone. Tone is independent of depth.

origin.description: Optional lineage link to an existing question in another language. Languages remain independent corpora.

author.description: Optional free-text credit. Courtesy only, no legal claim; all questions are CC0.

added.description: ISO date the entry was merged. Set by validate.py --fix.

x-tischkarte.description: Project config consumed by the validation and build tools. Not part of the JSON Schema vocabulary.
